chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas ibn al-Walid ibn Sabih, from his father, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "Do not buy from a craftsman (muharif), for his trade/craft has no blessing in it."

key_terms.بَرَكَةَ: Blessing, divine grace, or increase in goodness.
key_terms.مُحَارَفٍ: A craftsman or artisan, one who practices a specific trade or craft.

ai.seo_question: Why should one avoid buying from a muharif according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises against purchasing from a *muharif* (artisan), noting that their trade lacks *barakah* (divine blessing). While some scholars interpret this as a specific critique of artisans who may neglect religious duties for their craft, others view it as a general principle regarding the spiritual integrity of one's livelihood, emphasizing that the source of goods impacts their spiritual value.
